items.difficulty_reason: Cardinal bound for acyclic submodules: defines |F| as the sum of cardinalities of F^n(U) over the site (whose size is set-sized by the conventions), then builds acyclic submodules F_n inductively so that each inclusion F_n -> F_{n+1} induces zero on cohomology sheaves, and concludes that F = union F_n is a nonzero acyclic submodule of size <= kappa, using that only a set of isomorphism classes has bounded size. Retained author proof at lines 3862-3949.
